wizard-origin.observed: Cargo Registration, step 1; Chicago (USCHI) selected by default; 13 locations offered by name and UN/LOCODE; Cancel and Next are present.
wizard-origin.predicted: Booking.init selects today's state and lists shipping locations; the first flow page offers origin selection.

wizard-destination.input: Press Next on step 1 with Chicago selected.
wizard-destination.observed: Step 2 names Chicago as origin, defaults destination to Dallas (USDAL), and offers 12 locations excluding Chicago; Back, Cancel and Next are present. Back preserves Chicago.
wizard-destination.predicted: The destination page removes the selected origin from choices and supports backward/cancel/forward navigation.

wizard-deadline.input: Press Next with Chicago → Dallas, then select November 7 and November 8, 2026.
wizard-deadline.observed: The calendar displays November 2026; dates before the current date have no links. Selecting November 7 displays “A journey can't start and end the same day!” and disables Book Cargo. November 8 displays “Journey duration is one day.” and enables Book Cargo.
wizard-deadline.predicted: Duration includes a four-hour grace period, is truncated to standard days, and booking requires at least one day.

registration.input: Complete Chicago → Dallas booking with arrival deadline November 8, 2026.
registration.observed: Book Cargo returns to the dashboard and adds a NOT_ROUTED cargo with empty itinerary. The observed tracking ID was D613CF52; another booking produced B147E0B7. Both are eight-character uppercase UUID prefixes. Deadline is shown as 11/08/2026.
registration.predicted: BookingService creates and stores cargo with generated tracking ID and the selected RouteSpecification; its initial delivery is NOT_RECEIVED / NOT_ROUTED with no itinerary.

dashboard.input: Open admin/dashboard.xhtml after application startup and after registering cargo.
dashboard.observed: Three tables render in order: Routed Cargo, Not Routed Cargo, Claimed Cargo. No custom empty-table text or pager appears. The post-registration view showed seeded routed rows ABC123/JKL567/DEF789, newly booked unrouted rows, and claimed row MNO456.
dashboard.predicted: The dashboard includes the three table fragments inside the shared admin template.

route-candidates.input: Open admin/route.xhtml?trackingId=DEF789, then open a newly registered Chicago → Dallas cargo with a next-day deadline.
route-candidates.observed: DEF789 produced four candidate itineraries on each observed request, with randomized legs, voyages and dates. The short-deadline Chicago → Dallas cargo showed Potential routes: 0 and “No routes found that satisfy the route specification. Try setting an arrival deadline further into the future.”
route-candidates.predicted: The pathfinder generates 3–5 random candidates without using the deadline; the adapter then rejects candidates not satisfying the strict route specification.

route-assignment.input: Select the first displayed candidate for DEF789.
route-assignment.observed: The route is assigned and persisted; the browser reaches /admin/show.xhtml?trackingId=DEF789 and renders the itinerary legs. The selected candidate's final destination is Melbourne.
route-assignment.predicted: ItinerarySelection.assignItinerary returns a show.html outcome, while the running Faces UI resolves the navigation to show.xhtml and renders cargo details.

destination-dialog.input: Open the not-routed cargo destination editor for D613CF52, select New York (USNYC), and Update.
destination-dialog.observed: The modal shows origin Chicago and current destination Dallas. Options exclude Chicago and Dallas; the initial option was Gothenburg. After Update the dialog closes and the table shows New York, preserving origin and deadline; the cargo remains in Not Routed Cargo. Browser console reports “Widget for var 'mainDash_tableNotRouted_0_toUpdate_dlgwidget' not available!” while the update succeeds.
destination-dialog.predicted: The edit bean loads cargo and shipping locations, filters origin/current destination, changes the specification, closes with DONE, and the table refreshes.

deadline-dialog.input: Open the deadline editor for D613CF52, enter 1/15/27, dismiss the date picker, and Update.
deadline-dialog.observed: The modal shows Chicago → New York and current value 11/8/26. After Update the table displays 01/15/2027; the dialog closes and cargo remains not routed. Browser console reports “Widget for var 'mainDash_tableNotRouted_0_arrivalDeadlineToUpdate_dlgwidget' not available!” while the update succeeds.
deadline-dialog.predicted: The deadline edit bean parses the displayed date, calls changeDeadline, closes the dynamic dialog, and refreshes the table.

cargo-details.input: Open the claimed cargo MNO456 from the dashboard.
cargo-details.observed: The link opens Cargo Details with origin, destination, arrival deadline and an itinerary table. It does not show handling-event history.
cargo-details.predicted: show.xhtml renders cargo routing details and itinerary; the claimed-table link's tooltip promises history.

unknown-cargo-error.observed: HTTP 500; Mojarra error page title is “Error - java.lang.NullPointerException” and displays the exception.
unknown-cargo-error.predicted: The repository returns null for an unknown tracking ID; the facade/assembler path dereferences it without a not-found branch.

select-itinerary-with-candidates.input: Open admin/selectItinerary.xhtml?trackingId=DEF789 after confirming it has four candidates.
select-itinerary-with-candidates.observed: HTTP 200 page contains only the admin navigation; no route options or body message is rendered.
select-itinerary-with-candidates.predicted: The page renders only the empty-candidate message, so a non-empty candidate list leaves the page content blank.

select-itinerary-without-candidates.input: Open admin/selectItinerary.xhtml?trackingId=B147E0B7 for the next-day Chicago → Dallas cargo.
select-itinerary-without-candidates.observed: The page displays “No routes found that satisfy the route specification. Try setting an arrival deadline further into the future (a few weeks at least).”
select-itinerary-without-candidates.predicted: When routeCandidates is empty, the page renders its no-routes guidance.

source-tests.input: Run the source CargoTest, ItineraryTest and RouteSpecificationTest in a writable scratch copy using Java 8.
source-tests.observed: 16 unique tests passed: CargoTest 9, ItineraryTest 3, RouteSpecificationTest 4. A separate ItineraryTest run also passed all 3 tests. BookingServiceTest was not run; its tests are Arquillian integration tests.
source-tests.predicted: These source unit tests assert cargo initial/routing states, itinerary event matching/construction and route-specification endpoint/deadline checks.

booking.cargo-not-found.observed: Unknown route lookup returns HTTP 500 with a NullPointerException page.
booking.cargo-not-found.predicted: Null cargo is dereferenced; there is no explicit not-found branch.

booking.dashboard-chain.observed: Dashboard renders the three cargo tables through the admin shell.
booking.dashboard-chain.predicted: The page composes routed, not-routed and claimed table fragments.

booking.dashboard-filters.observed: Seeded routed and claimed cargos and newly registered NOT_ROUTED cargos appear in their corresponding tables.
booking.dashboard-filters.predicted: ListCargo partitions the fetched CargoRoute DTOs by routing and claimed state.

booking.deadline-change.observed: Updating the deadline to 1/15/27 changes the table display to 01/15/2027 without routing the cargo.
booking.deadline-change.predicted: The updated deadline replaces the route specification and recalculates cargo routing state.

booking.destination-change.observed: Updating destination to New York preserves Chicago origin and the existing deadline; cargo remains not routed.
booking.destination-change.predicted: The service replaces the route specification without requesting or assigning a route.

booking.dialog-chain.observed: Both not-routed table actions open PrimeFaces dynamic dialogs and successful updates close and refresh the table.
booking.dialog-chain.predicted: Dialog beans receive trackingId, call the facade, close with DONE, and dialogReturn refreshes the table.

booking.dialog-deadline.observed: The deadline dialog loads 11/8/26 and updates to 01/15/2027.
booking.dialog-deadline.predicted: The bean parses with MM/dd/yyyy, invokes the service, and closes with DONE.

booking.dialog-destination.observed: The dialog displays origin/current destination and filters both from choices; update persists.
booking.dialog-destination.predicted: Potential destinations exclude origin/current destination; the backing list is mutated by the getter.

booking.registration.observed: A valid three-step booking returns to the dashboard with a new NOT_ROUTED cargo and generated tracking ID.
booking.registration.predicted: The service creates cargo with an empty itinerary and default delivery state.

booking.routing-assign.observed: Selected itinerary persists and UI opens the .xhtml cargo details page.
booking.routing-assign.predicted: The bean returns a show.html outcome; the running UI resolves it to show.xhtml.

booking.routing-candidates.observed: Known cargo returns four observed candidates or zero after deadline filtering; unknown cargo fails with HTTP 500.
booking.routing-candidates.predicted: Candidates are generated and filtered by route specification; missing cargo returns an empty list in the service path.

booking.routing-chain.observed: Route page displays candidates and assignment opens details with the chosen itinerary.
booking.routing-chain.predicted: The facade calls routing, maps candidates, assigns selected itinerary, and updates cargo.

booking.routing-pathfinder-api.observed: The page received four randomized candidate routes for DEF789; short deadline produced none.
booking.routing-pathfinder-api.predicted: The external API receives origin/destination, omits deadline, and returns random paths that are post-filtered.

booking.screen-cargo-details.observed: Details display origin, destination, deadline and itinerary; claimed-cargo link does not show history.
booking.screen-cargo-details.predicted: show.xhtml renders cargo route details and itinerary legs.

booking.screen-claimed-table.observed: MNO456 appears in Claimed Cargo and opens the routing-details page.
booking.screen-claimed-table.predicted: The claimed table link points to show.xhtml although its tooltip promises history.

booking.screen-dashboard.observed: Dashboard shows Routed Cargo, Not Routed Cargo and Claimed Cargo sections.
booking.screen-dashboard.predicted: Those three table includes are the dashboard content.

booking.screen-deadline.observed: Same-day deadline displays an error and disables booking; next-day deadline displays one-day duration and enables booking.
booking.screen-deadline.predicted: Bookable is true only when the grace-adjusted duration is at least one standard day.

booking.screen-destination.observed: Destination menu excludes the selected Chicago origin and defaults to Dallas.
booking.screen-destination.predicted: Booking.locations filters the selected origin while on the destination page.

booking.screen-not-routed-table.observed: New cargos are listed with route link, origin, destination and editable deadline; dialogReturn refreshes their row.
booking.screen-not-routed-table.predicted: The not-routed fragment binds ListCargo.notRoutedCargos and exposes destination/deadline dialogs.

booking.screen-origin.observed: Origin page defaults to Chicago and offers 13 locations.
booking.screen-origin.predicted: The first wizard page binds Booking.locations with Cancel and Next actions.

booking.screen-route.observed: Route page shows cargo endpoints, deadline, candidate count and numbered candidate leg tables, or the no-routes message.
booking.screen-route.predicted: The page renders the populated candidate table or no-route branch.

booking.screen-routed-table.observed: Routed cargos display tracking ID, origin, destination, last-known location, transport status and deadline; a newly assigned route moves into this table.
booking.screen-routed-table.predicted: The table binds routed-unclaimed cargos and renders those fields.

booking.screen-select-itinerary.observed: With four candidates the page body is blank; with none it displays no-routes guidance.
booking.screen-select-itinerary.predicted: The page only renders an empty-candidate message; populated route tables are rendered in route.xhtml.

booking.wizard-chain.observed: Book → origin → destination → deadline → Book Cargo returns to dashboard with a new cargo; Back returns to origin and Cancel returns to dashboard.
booking.wizard-chain.predicted: The flow-scoped Booking bean carries selections through three pages and calls the booking facade on submit.

booking.wizard-input-rules.observed: The UI excludes the selected origin from destinations; same-day deadline shows an error and disables Book Cargo.
booking.wizard-input-rules.predicted: Equal locations produce a FacesMessage; duration is computed with a four-hour grace period and booking is disabled below one day.
